images.caption: Figure 1: Structured skill composition with SkillComposer. (A) Large skill libraries create a composition bottleneck. To solve complex tasks, an agent must decide not only which skills to use, but also their exact count and execution order. (B) Existing paradigms: directly exposing the agent to all skill options leaves composition implicit within an unstructured execution trace, while retrieval methods only return an unordered subset of candidates. We propose SkillComposer, which explicitly predicts an ordered, executable skill sequence. (C) By structuring the composition process, SkillComposer improves both plan exact match and downstream task success rates on SkillsBench.
